title: Crawfish
description: A Minecraft mod that introduces a crawfish trapping and cooking mechanic, complete with custom rewards and custom food items.
body:
# Crawfish Mod

This mod expands Minecraft's swamps and oceans by adding a fully automated trapping system and a unique cooking mechanic for Crawfish. It adds 5 different crawfish variants, a custom block, and new high-tier food options.

## How it works

### 1. Catching Crawfish
To start, you need to craft a **Crawfish Trap**. Place it underwater in any swamp, river, or ocean biome. The trap works automatically over time and will slowly collect raw crawfish. You have to put spam, chicken, kelp, bread or any other meat i8n the trap so it works. 

There are 5 different color variants you can catch:
* Blue Crawfish
* Yellow Crawfish
* Green Crawfish
* Purple Crawfish
* Orange Crawfish

### 2. Boiling Mechanics (Cauldron Cooking)
You cannot cook these crawfish in a standard furnace or smoker. Instead, you have to boil them using a water cauldron.
* Place a **Cauldron** down and fill it with **Water**.
* Place a **Lava block** directly underneath the cauldron to heat it up.
* Toss your raw crawfish into the boiling water. 
* The crawfish will cook instantly, showing bubble and smoke particles, and pop out as a finished item.

### 3. Food Values
Eating raw crawfish isn't very effective (restores only 1 hunger bar). However, once boiled, any of the 5 cooked crawfish variants becomes an excellent food source, restoring **5 full hunger bars (10 hunger points)** with high saturation.
